title: A foreach loop over a package variable frees the GV it iterates, and pp_iter reads it again
live_proof: upstream fixed it in ad5fedb002 (ad5fedb002a4e7befcb1bd42bd788878f37a0d6e) (2022-11-15). That commit is an ancestor of v5.45.3-85-gdb19522155 and is NOT an ancestor of the v5.36.3 tag (checked with git merge-base --is-ancestor, both directions), so it never reached the 5.36 maintenance branch; the pin's tree shows the unfixed code (pin pp_ctl.c:2258 itersave = GvSV(sv) with no SvREFCNT_inc(sv); inline.h:3079 cx_poploop has no CXp_FOR_GV/LVREF decrement). Host ASan at the pin: ASan: SEGV (rc=77); the same trigger, same harness and same ASan options on master: no report (rc=0, the harness reports [PASS])
fidelity: the trigger is the test upstream added with its own fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it
